setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An artisan wonders whether distant people could make an animal-shaped automaton that moves without breathing or eating.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A mechanism works briefly before sand jams its pivot.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A healer compares motion with metabolism, reproduction, and healing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child points out that sleeping animals barely move and are unquestionably alive.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A lonely elder likes the thought of a tireless walking companion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A friend asks whether such a companion could offer affection or merely imitate it.

a1__fx.text: The builders design a harmless wooden joint and learn why balance is difficult.
